ci.source_identity: All 15 local Lean source/configuration files were byte-for-byte matched against the checked merge commit.

proofs.claim: Complete bilinear composite Hessian chain rule
proofs.assumptions: Real normed vector spaces; f and g globally differentiable; their first Frechet derivatives differentiable at the evaluation points.
proofs.conclusion: D²(f∘g)[u,v] = D²f[Dg u,Dg v] + Df[D²g[u,v]], using actual Frechet derivatives.
proofs.scope: No stationarity, prescribed Hessian value, or Einstein-operator hypothesis is assumed. The theorem does not construct the microscopic UBT action or connection map.

proofs.claim: Complete second derivative along a curve
proofs.assumptions: f is differentiable; its first derivative has derivative H at g(t); g has derivative g₁ at every point; g₁ has derivative g₂ at t.
proofs.conclusion: The second derivative is H(g₁(t),g₁(t)) + Df(g(t))[g₂].

proofs.claim: Determinant rank-one and mixed directional identities
proofs.assumptions: Arbitrary real 4×4 first jet, real inverse scale, field value, field-dependent additive shift and weight, covector and pair of field vectors.
proofs.conclusion: The determinant density is affine on common-covector first-jet variations and its mixed real derivative vanishes.
proofs.scope: The polynomial is proved equal to Matrix.det; no numerical sample or zero-derivative hypothesis replaces the proof.

proofs.assumptions: The same unrestricted pointwise real variables as the determinant density; the matrix norm is the elementwise norm.
proofs.conclusion: The actual second Frechet derivative contracted with a common spacetime covector is zero in every pair of field directions.
proofs.scope: Twice differentiability is proved from the determinant polynomial, rather than assumed. Field-value partial derivatives and the complete Euler PDE are separate statements.

proofs.claim: Nonzero global minimum of the existing quartic potential
proofs.assumptions: All complex 2x2 matrices; lambda1>=0, lambda2>0 and mu<0; equivalently r>0 and mu=-(4*lambda1+lambda2)*r^2. The lower-bound theorem also covers nonnegative lambda2 and arbitrary real r.
proofs.conclusion: X0=i*r*I attains Vmin=V0-(4*lambda1+lambda2)*r^4. The universal H<=2*norm(det X) inequality, norm/trace invariant identity, negative-mu parameterization, invariant equality conditions and strict null-ray gap are proved in the same module.
proofs.scope: An exact pointwise theorem in the original eight-real-component biquaternionic algebra. It does not select the coefficients or prove a full-action spacetime vacuum.

proofs.claim: Actual second variation and positivity in all eight real field directions
proofs.assumptions: An arbitrary eight-real-component affine variation; r>0, lambda1>=0, lambda2>0 for strict positivity and the kernel characterization.
proofs.conclusion: The actual twice-differentiated quartic is 2*r^2*((4*lambda1+lambda2)*(v1+v3)^2+lambda2*((v0-v2)^2+(v4+v6)^2+(v5-v7)^2)). It is nonnegative, positive off the four kernel equations, and zero exactly on them.
proofs.scope: The polynomial expansion and actual derivatives are proved, rather than assumed. No kinetic operator or physical particle mass is inferred.

proofs.claim: Exact global classification of the minimizing symmetry orbit
proofs.assumptions: All complex 2x2 matrices; r>0, lambda1>=0, lambda2>0 and mu=-(4*lambda1+lambda2)*r^2.
proofs.conclusion: V(X)=Vmin if and only if X=u*r*S*S^dagger with norm(u)=1 and det(S)=1. Both directions are proved.
proofs.scope: The proof constructs a unit phase from the nonzero trace, proves Hermitian entry relations from saturation, constructs a triangular factor and normalizes its determinant. No Hermitian ansatz, physical gauge quotient, new field or spacetime vacuum is assumed.

remaining_formalization.claim: B-VAR integrated covariant Euler and Jacobi formulas
remaining_formalization.missing: Exterior differential calculus, compact-support integration by parts and equality of integrated mixed variations.
The principal first-jet Hessian is checked; the complete Euler operator and its differential-order deduction are not formalized.
Eigenvalue multiplicities, identification of phase/boost tangent generators, and the conditional constant-H tetrad-rank argument are not formalized in this module.

limitations: The volume lemmas restrict the same biquaternionic Theta to its four Lorentz-real coordinates; the potential theorem varies all eight real coordinates. Neither introduces a new physical field or independent tetrad.
A general derivative-dependent or implicit composite connection still needs a specified differentiable solution map and a full action variation.
The physical quantum operator, gauge/ghost quotient, contour, nonzero positive Einstein coefficient, UV scale and renormalization are not derived here.
This record is not a proof of full UBT, induced Newton's constant, RH, or every scientific statement elsewhere in the PR.
